text.en: Here we are. This is Mirage Inn. It is quiet now, but it is still holding this place together.
text.zh: 到了。这里就是蜃影客栈。它现在很安静，但它还在撑住这个地方。

text.en: From today on, it is your place too.
text.zh: 从今天开始，它也是你的地方了。

text.en: There are three important rooms here. I will show them to you one by one.
text.zh: 这里有三个重要的房间。我会一个一个带你认识。

text.en: The room in the middle is the formation room. We start here, because the inn's biggest problem is inside.
text.zh: 中间这间，是阵法房间。我们先看这里，因为客栈现在最大的问题就在里面。

text.en: There should be six artifacts here.
text.zh: 这里本来应该有六件神器。

text.en: One guards sound, one guards words, and one guards sentences.
text.zh: 一个守住声音，一个守住词，一个守住句子。

text.en: The other three guard the roads from this inn to the distant lands.
text.zh: 还有三个，守住客栈通向远方的路。

text.en: But they are lost. I know that already. Now I need you to know it too.
text.zh: 可是它们已经遗失了。我早就知道这件事。现在，我也需要你知道。

text.en: Not to scare you. To show you this: the inn is not broken. It is waiting for us to bring back what is missing.
text.zh: 不是为了吓你。是想让你明白：客栈不是坏了，它是在等我们把缺的东西找回来。

text.en: The artifacts are gone, but the formation is still here. As long as it remains, the road is not cut off.
text.zh: 神器不在，阵还在。阵还在，路就没有断。

text.en: Look. The formation still remembers where each artifact belongs. We will bring them back, one by one.
text.zh: 你看，阵还记得每件神器的位置。我们会一件一件，把它们找回来。

text.en: Now come this way. The room on the left is your room.
text.zh: 现在来这边。左边这间，是你的房间。

text.en: The inn recognizes its owner. You do not need to push the door. It will let you in.
text.zh: 客栈认得主人。你不用推门，它会自己让你进去。

text.en: There are two important things here: the bookshelf and the wardrobe.
text.zh: 这里有两样重要的东西：书架，还有衣橱。

text.en: The bookshelf is not just for books. Behind it is the Word Spirit Library.
text.zh: 书架不只是放书的地方。它后面连着词灵书阁。

text.en: When you learn a new word, it can become a word spirit and live there.
text.zh: 你学会的新词，会在那里变成词灵，住进书阁里。

text.en: Each word spirit remembers its spelling and its sound.
text.zh: 每个词灵，都记得自己的拼写，也记得自己的声音。

text.en: Visit them often. If you can call a word clearly, the word spirit will become clearer too.
text.zh: 常去看看它们。你能清楚地叫出一个词，词灵也会变得更清楚。

text.en: Now try calling it. Just say: bookshelf.
text.zh: 现在，试着叫它。只要说：书架。

text.en: I heard you.
text.zh: 我听见了。

text.en: Good. It knows your voice now.
text.zh: 很好。它现在认得你的声音了。

text.en: This is the Word Spirit Library.
text.zh: 这里就是词灵书阁。

text.en: It is small now. When you know more words, it will become much livelier.
text.zh: 它现在还很小。等你认识的词越来越多，这里也会越来越热闹。

text.en: Can you call my name?
text.zh: 你会叫我的名字吗？

text.en: This is your first word spirit. It is not steady yet. Help it stand clearly.
text.zh: 这是你的第一个词灵。它还不太稳，需要你帮它站清楚。

text.en: Listen to its sound. Then say the word: {word_text}.
text.zh: 听它的声音，然后说出这个词：{word_text}。

text.en: I am clearer now!
text.zh: 我变清楚一点了！

text.en: Good. Now help it hold its letters in place. Spell the word: {word_text}.
text.zh: 很好。现在帮它把字母站稳。拼出这个词：{word_text}。

text.en: My name is standing steady.
text.zh: 我的名字站稳了。

text.en: Remember this place. The words you learn will return here.
text.zh: 记住这个地方。你学会的词，都会回到这里。

text.en: They are not homework. They are friends you know, and keys to the roads ahead.
text.zh: 它们不是作业。它们是你认识的朋友，也是打开远方道路的钥匙。

text.en: On the other side is the wardrobe.
text.zh: 另一边是衣橱。

text.en: New outfits and new looks you earn will wait for you here.
text.zh: 你得到的新衣服、新装扮，都会在这里等你。

text.en: It is a little empty now. That is fine. Empty space is for future rewards.
text.zh: 它现在还空着一点。没关系，空位是留给以后奖励的。

text.en: The room on the right is the guest room.
text.zh: 右边这间，是客房。

text.en: When the inn recovers, guests will come and stay here.
text.zh: 客栈恢复以后，会有客人来这里住下。

text.en: They will bring stories, requests, and real conversations for you to practice.
text.zh: 他们会带来故事、委托，也会带来真正可以练习的会话。

text.en: Hello...?
text.zh: Hello……？

text.en: Did you hear that? The road is not completely cut off.
text.zh: 听见了吗？路还没有完全断。

text.en: Now we know what each room does.
text.zh: 现在，我们知道每个房间是做什么的了。

text.en: The formation room helps us find the six artifacts.
text.zh: 阵法房间，帮我们找回六件神器。

text.en: Your room helps you care for word spirits and keep your rewards.
text.zh: 你的房间，帮你照顾词灵，也保存你的奖励。

text.en: The guest room is waiting for travelers to return.
text.zh: 客房，等着远方的客人回来。

text.en: You do not need to remember everything at once. Today, remember one thing.
text.zh: 你不用一下子记住全部。今天，你只要记住一件事。

text.en: When you learn a word, call it clearly. The word spirit will hear you, and the inn will hear you too.
text.zh: 当你学会一个词，就清楚地叫出它。词灵会听见，客栈也会听见。

text.en: Good. The first light is already awake. We start there.
text.zh: 好了。第一点光已经醒了。我们从它开始。
